# czc-v2026.10.26.1 (0.2.17.31)

GPT account astra health checks (Tibo probes) stay on schedule. A
rate limit that is lifted early no longer stops an account's checks
for days, and accounts whose checks always fail are checked less often.

## Changes since czc-v2026.10.25.1

### Astra health checks resume after a rate limit is lifted

- Before: a rate limit pushed the account's next check out to the
  limit's reset time and never pulled it back. Account 23156 kept
  serving traffic while its next check sat 5 days out. Its dots
  stopped updating and its state turned `unknown`.
- Now rate limits, overload and pauses are tracked separately from
  the check schedule and re-read from the database every minute. A
  cleared limit resumes checks within about a minute.
- The (possibly stale) account copy used for request routing no
  longer sets these limits.

### Fewer wasted checks

- Consecutive 400/401/403/404 rejections back off: 10, 20, 40, 80,
  then every 120 minutes. This covers free plans without
  `gpt-6-astra` and relays that refuse the check. Any real result,
  429/408, or network error returns to the normal 10 ± 5 minutes.
- Paused, disabled and expired accounts are no longer reloaded from
  the database every minute. Deleted and error-status accounts are
  removed from memory. The admin page still shows their saved dots.
- A check's Retry-After is capped at 1 hour. Longer resets are
  already tracked by the account's own rate-limit field.
- Failed (unknown) checks no longer rewrite the account row.

### Verdict details

- After the 10-minute wait before degraded can return to healthy, a
  check that still disagrees now waits the normal 20 seconds before
  the next one, instead of re-checking on the next 6-second tick.
- The returned model name is compared case-insensitively, like the
  existing check on normal requests.

### Admin data

- `next_probe_at` is now the real next check time, including any
  limit. New fields: `held_until`, `parked`, `client_error_streak`.
  The frontend does not display them yet.

## VERSION

`0.2.17.31`

## Upgrade guidance

Drop-in. No database migration and no configuration change.

After restart, in-memory schedules start empty. Accounts get their
first check within 10 minutes, staggered. Always-failing accounts
start again at 10 minutes, then back off.

## Compatibility

- Request forwarding, billing and scheduling are unchanged. The
  verdict still only drives the admin dots and the `route_degraded`
  label (`scheduler_prefer_healthy_route` is off).
- Saved verdicts and dots in `codex_tibo_verdict:http` keep the same
  format.
- `gateway.openai_tibo_route.unknown_backoff` is still accepted and
  still unused; the client-error backoff is built in.

## Rollback

Redeploy `czc-v2026.10.25.1`, or restore the backup
`/opt/sub2api/sub2api.bak.czc-v2026.10.26.1-<UTC timestamp>` created
during this deploy and restart `sub2api.service`. Rolling back brings
back the stuck-schedule bug and the per-cadence checks of failing
accounts. Saved verdicts are compatible both ways.
